context:
Goal: land the waiting-page test lane's changes without more than one full CI run per change.
Problem (rule): the waiting-page lane wants to start a full CI run by hand on every head, but your rule is one full CI run per change.
Based on (read): the coordinator's audit of ruling page-tests-served-font (roadmap/rulings/page-tests-served-font.json, status open, filed by triage Nov 13 from PR 2347's body). It says "prove each head with a dispatched checks run". The words are the coordinator's, relayed by a lane, not a quote from you.
Based on (ruling): rule roles-each-layer-proves-once in CLAUDE.md: the PR run is the merge check, and a change is proved once per layer. No decision or ruling on the roadmap branch or in docs/decisions answers this for the page lane.
Departs from: main (one full CI run per change) — a lane starts an extra full run by hand on every head.
Meanwhile: the lane keeps its font tests; nothing else waits on this.

options.gain: One full run per change, nothing extra queued.
options.how: The lane drops the hand-started run on each head. The PR's own run is its proof.
options.label: No: the lane keeps its tests and proves on the PR run only
options.lose: The lane's font test is proven later, at the PR run.

options.how: The page lane starts a full run by hand on every head, as ruling page-tests-served-font says.
options.label: Yes, for the page lane only
options.lose: Extra full runs while the CI budget is tight.

ref: page-tests-served-font (the ruling that the page lane proves each head with a dispatched checks run)
reply: ruled page-tests-served-font: the page lane proves on the PR run only

shown.label: No: the lane keeps its tests and proves on the PR run only
Yes, for the page lane only

title: Does the waiting-page lane get an extra full CI run by hand on every head, against your rule of one per change?
